<script>
(function(){try{
var extras=document.getElementById('dashExtras');
var firstW=document.querySelector('.dash-widget');
if(!firstW)return;
var chartsRow=extras?extras.parentNode.parentNode:null;
var wrap=document.createElement('div');wrap.id='dashWidgets';wrap.className='dash-widgets-wrap';
firstW.parentNode.insertBefore(wrap,firstW);
var all=[].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('.dash-widget'));
var byKey={};all.forEach(function(w){byKey[w.getAttribute('data-wkey')]=w;});
var def=['salesKpi','opsKpi','health','hourly','payments','products'];
var saved=("${dashOrderCsv}").split(',').filter(Boolean);
var seq=[];saved.forEach(function(k){if(byKey[k]&&seq.indexOf(k)<0)seq.push(k);});
def.forEach(function(k){if(byKey[k]&&seq.indexOf(k)<0)seq.push(k);});
seq.forEach(function(k){wrap.appendChild(byKey[k]);});
if(extras)wrap.parentNode.insertBefore(extras,wrap.nextSibling);
if(chartsRow&&chartsRow.parentNode)chartsRow.parentNode.removeChild(chartsRow);
var dragEl=null;
all.forEach(function(w){
var h=w.querySelector('.dash-handle');if(!h)return;
h.addEventListener('mousedown',function(){w.setAttribute('draggable','true');});
w.addEventListener('dragstart',function(e){dragEl=w;w.classList.add('dragging');try{e.dataTransfer.effectAllowed='move';e.dataTransfer.setData('text/plain','x');}catch(_e){}});
w.addEventListener('dragend',function(){w.classList.remove('dragging');w.removeAttribute('draggable');saveOrder();});
});
wrap.addEventListener('dragover',function(e){e.preventDefault();if(!dragEl)return;var a=afterEl(e.clientY);if(a==null)wrap.appendChild(dragEl);else wrap.insertBefore(dragEl,a);});
function afterEl(y){var els=[].slice.call(wrap.querySelectorAll('.dash-widget:not(.dragging)'));var res={o:-1e9,e:null};els.forEach(function(ch){var b=ch.getBoundingClientRect();var o=y-b.top-b.height/2;if(o<0&&o>res.o){res={o:o,e:ch};}});return res.e;}
function saveOrder(){var keys=[].slice.call(wrap.querySelectorAll('.dash-widget')).map(function(w){return w.getAttribute('data-wkey');});var base=("${ec.web.request.requestURI}").replace(/\/+$/,'');var body='order='+encodeURIComponent(keys.join(','))+'&moquiSessionToken='+encodeURIComponent("${ec.web.sessionToken}");fetch(base+'/saveDashOrder',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'},body:body,credentials:'same-origin'}).catch(function(){});}
}catch(_e){}})();
</script>
